question: Who captained India in the ICC Women’s Cricket World Cup, 2025, in November 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Harmanpreet Kaur**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Harmanpreet Kaur** served as the captain of the **Indian Women's Cricket Team** during the **ICC Women’s Cricket World Cup 2025**.
 
• The **2025** edition of the tournament was hosted by **India**, with matches scheduled across various venues during **September**, **October**, and **November 2025**.
 
• As a seasoned **all-rounder**, **Harmanpreet Kaur** took over the permanent captaincy roles in all formats following the retirement of legendary players. ***Hence, the correct answer is Harmanpreet Kaur.***
 
• The **ICC Women's World Cup 2025** was a significant event as it marked the return of the **ODI World Cup** to **India** after the **2013** edition.
